date.as_written: śrīsaṃvat 1880 sauramānena pauṣamāsa dina 11 gate budhavāsare

notes: The closing verse invokes Vidyātīrtha (stock benedictory stanza associated with Sāyaṇa's works). The dated note at the end records an astrological calculation/auspicious journey (yātrā śubhā) with recommendations for gifts (dāna); no scribe or patron is mentioned.
